verdict.after: Actual focused native GREEN: A retained the exact dirty draft while B and SQL showed the new authoritative remote title; A then saved through the real UI, SQL and both clients converged to that exact draft, and both save buttons became disabled.
verdict.permanent: Same permanent test source bytes produced RED against the old production source and GREEN against the minimal repaired source; the original Q33 checks remained passing.
